technical_summary: Enterprise customer running hybrid inference: primary workload is interactive chat + heavy reranking/embeddings. Goal is a dedicated pool that guarantees throughput (800-1,200 req/s for batch pipelines) and tight latency SLOs (p95<120ms chat). Evaluating model-specific tuning: 70B model with nf4/awq profiles for day-to-day, int8 as fallback for cost bursts; context lengths split (8k for chat, 32k for long-form summarization). Plan includes per-session KV cache (12h TTL), micro-batching for chat to meet latency, and routing policies that fallback to smaller variants or hosted instances during capacity pressure.
